t: Five things he asked not to live to see
a: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ خَمْسٌ إِذَا ابْتُلِيتُمْ بِهِنَّ وَأَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ تُدْرِكُوهُنَّ
p: Yā maʿshara-l-muhājirīn, khamsun idha-btulītum bihinna, wa aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi an tudrikūhunn
m: Company of the Emigrants, there are five things. If you are tested with them, and I seek refuge in Allah that you should live to see them.
